manifest.contractionPolicy: contraction uses the existing adaptive shrink rule, never growing, only after the delay; the production highDiversityThreshold is 0.8 but a 3-seed pilot showed 1.3-2.3 species per 24 creatures so the shrink branch never fired; the study sets contractionHighDiversityThreshold to 0, so the rule contracts on every post-delay plateau, bounded below by minPopulationFraction 0.5; the rule's low-diversity grow branch is disabled (lowDiversityThreshold 0) because it is checked first and would pre-empt the shrink
manifest.budgetPolicy: records charged held equal; holdout and diversity probe uncharged; wall-clock measured and reported, not capped
